scripts.text:
[Nemuk]
You seem to be an
outsider, so let me
ask you something.
What do you think 
of Einbech?
scripts.translation:
[内穆克]
你看起来像是个外乡人，
所以我想问你个问题。
你觉得艾音贝赫怎么样？

scripts.text: It's fine.
scripts.translation: 还不错。

scripts.text: It looks tough to live here.
scripts.translation: 住在这里很艰难。

scripts.text:
[Nemuk]
Huh...?
I'm not sure what
you've seen, but I'm
surprised to hear you
say something like that.
scripts.translation:
[内穆克]
咦...？
我不确定你看到了什么，
但听到你这么说，
我感到很惊讶。

scripts.text:
[Nemuk]
It's been ten years since
I've started to think about
moving out. However, I'm still
debating it. Now, if I were rich, I'd leave in no time, but it's hard getting the money to move out.
scripts.translation:
[内穆克]
从我开始考虑搬走以来，
已经十年了。但我仍在犹豫。
如果我有钱，我早就走了，
但想攒够搬家的钱很难。

scripts.text:
[Nemuk]
^333333*Sigh...*^000000
Maybe if I had been
an adventurer when I was
younger, I wouldn't have
these problems today...
scripts.translation:
[内穆克]
^333333*叹气...*^000000
如果我年轻时是个冒险者，
今天就不会有这些烦恼了...

scripts.text:
[Nemuk]
I thought so.
Well, I apologize if
I put you on the spot.
scripts.translation:
[内穆克]
我想也是。
抱歉，如果我让你感到尴尬了。

scripts.text:
[Nemuk]
Everyone here has been
having a tough time just
living day to day for as long
as I can remember. It's like
things never seem to get any
better, no matter what we do.
scripts.translation:
[内穆克]
据我所知，这里的人
一直过着艰难的日子，
勉强维持生计。无论我们做什么，
情况似乎都不会好转。

scripts.text:
[Nemuk]
I really want to leave,
but it's just an empty
wish. My body is trapped
here while my heart longs
for a much better life. ^333333*Sigh*^000000
Is it hopeless? What can I do?
scripts.translation:
[内穆克]
我真的很想离开，
但这只是空想。我的身体被困在这里，
而我的心向往着更好的生活。^333333*叹气*^000000
是不是没希望了？我能做什么？

scripts.text:
[Heinz]
Wow...
An adventurer from
Rune-Midgarts, eh?
What brings you here?
scripts.translation:
[海因茨]
哇...
来自卢恩·米德加兹的冒险者，是吗？
是什么把你带到这里的？

scripts.text:
[Heinz]
Einbech doesn't offer much
in terms of sight-seeing, but
have you come to see the mine?
Right now, it's swarming with
monsters and we can't dig any
ores because it's so dangerous.
scripts.translation:
[海因茨]
艾音贝赫没什么观光景点，
但你是来看矿场的吗？
现在那里魔物横行，
太危险了，我们没法开采矿石。

scripts.text:
[Heinz]
Now, if some adventurers were
generous enough to hunt down
those evil creatures, we'd be able to mine again and they could earn some extra zeny. It's like killing two birds with one stone. Hahaha!
scripts.translation:
[海因茨]
如果有冒险者愿意出手，
消灭那些邪恶的生物，
我们就能重新开采，
他们也能赚点外快。一举两得。哈哈！

scripts.text:
[Heinz]
Oh wait... I'm sorry.
I don't know what's wrong
with me, asking complete
strangers to do favors for
me. It's completely rude!
I mean, who would do that?
scripts.translation:
[海因茨]
啊，等等...抱歉。
我不知道自己怎么了，
竟然向完全陌生的路人
请求帮忙。这太失礼了！
我是说，谁会这么做呢？

scripts.text:
[Heinz]
But... I'm beyond caring
about my pride. For the sake
of all that is good and holy, I'm begging you, please kill those foul and evil creatures. Please~!
scripts.translation:
[海因茨]
但是...我已经不在乎面子了。
为了所有美好神圣的事物，
我恳求你，请消灭那些肮脏邪恶的生物。
拜托了~！

scripts.text:
[Mogan]
Recently, there were a few
cave-ins where many miners
were injured. It was discussed
in the Town Council and in my
opinion, I think the miners dug
too deep and disturbed... ^FF0000it^000000.
scripts.translation:
[莫根]
最近，矿场发生了几次塌方，
许多矿工受伤。在城镇议会上讨论过，
依我看，矿工们挖得太深，
惊扰了...^FF0000它^000000。

scripts.text:
[Mogan]
Yes, they awoke Ungoliant,
the master of the caves that
has existed since ancient time.
I don't know how many more will
be victimized by Ungoliant in the
future. There's no telling...
scripts.translation:
[莫根]
是的，他们唤醒了温古力安特，
那个自远古时代就存在于洞穴中的主宰。
我不知道未来还会有多少人
成为温古力安特的受害者。
谁也不知道...

scripts.text:
[Mogan]
Adventurer, be careful
if you travel inside the
mines, lest your footsteps
disturb Ungoliant's slumber.
scripts.translation:
[莫根]
冒险者，如果你在矿洞内旅行，
请小心，以免你的脚步
惊扰了温古力安特的沉睡。

scripts.text:
[Hander]
Those Einbroch bastards!
Living off the resources we
dig up while we keep working
for them like suckers! Damn!
scripts.translation:
[汉德]
那些艾音布罗克的混蛋！
靠我们挖出的资源生活，
却让我们像傻瓜一样为他们工作！
该死！

scripts.text:
[Hander]
Everyday, we risk our
freakin' lives just so we
can make a living! Why don't
the elders do something about
this, like raise our ore prices?
scripts.translation:
[汉德]
每天，我们都冒着生命危险
只是为了谋生！为什么长老们
不采取点行动，比如提高矿石价格？

scripts.text:
[Hander]
The work schedule's
unreasonable, Cavitar's
wife was attacked by a mine
creature, the hospital's too
far away and we don't have
any food to eat! Why...?!
scripts.translation:
[汉德]
工作时间不合理，卡维塔尔的妻子
被矿洞生物袭击，医院又太远，
我们连吃的都没有！为什么...？！

scripts.text:
[Gushenmu]
I've lived here a long time
and, believe it or not, things
weren't as tough in the past
as they are right now.
scripts.translation:
[古神木]
我在这里住了很久了，
信不信由你，
过去的生活并没有
现在这么艰难。

scripts.text:
[Gushenmu]
For lots of different reasons,
the work is more dangerous
and we're running real low on
manpower. And the factories in
Einbroch make so much smog,
we can't even see sunlight here.
scripts.translation:
[古神木]
由于种种原因，
工作变得更加危险，
而且人手严重不足。
艾音布罗克的工厂
排放了太多烟雾，
我们在这里甚至看不见阳光。

scripts.text:
[Gushenmu]
The sad reality of mining
life right now is that we
wake up, go to work, and at
the end of the day, some of us
are injured while a few others never come to work the next day.
scripts.translation:
[古神木]
现在矿工生活的残酷现实是，
我们起床，去工作，
一天结束时，
有些人受伤了，
而有些人第二天
再也没有回来上班。

scripts.text:
[Gushenmu]
And as Einbech and Einbroch
have grown, I hear more and
more rumors that unfamiliar
monsters are beginning to
swarm outside of town. This
is really Einbech's worst time...
scripts.translation:
[古神木]
随着艾音贝赫和艾音布罗克的发展，
我听到越来越多的传言，
说陌生的魔物开始
在城镇外成群结队。
这真是艾音贝赫最糟糕的时期...

scripts.text:
[Staff]
Welcome to
the Train Station.
The fare to take the
train to Einbroch is
200 zeny. Would
you like to ride?
scripts.translation:
[职员]
欢迎来到车站。
前往艾音布罗克的
火车票价是200 Zeny。
您要乘坐吗？

scripts.text: Yes.
scripts.translation: 是的

scripts.text: No.
scripts.translation: 不。

scripts.text:
[Staff]
Thank you and
we hope you enjoy
the ride. All aboard!
scripts.translation:
[职员]
谢谢，
祝您旅途愉快。
各位乘客请上车！

scripts.text:
[Staff]
I'm sorry,
but you don't
have enough zeny
to pay the train fare.
scripts.translation:
[职员]
很抱歉，
您的Zeny不足，
无法支付火车票价。

scripts.text:
[Staff]
Please enjoy
your stay here
in Einbech.
scripts.translation:
[职员]
祝您在艾音贝赫
度过愉快的时光。

scripts.text:
[Train Station Manager]
This train station
is strictly for trains
running from Einbech
to Einbroch. Please speak
to the staff in the 11 'o clock direction if you'd like to board.
scripts.translation:
[车站管理员]
这个车站专门服务于
从艾音贝赫开往艾音布罗克的火车。
如果您想上车，
请去11点钟方向找职员对话。

scripts.text:
[Tollaf]
Ah...!
This is killing me!
I don't have the money
to move, but I don't wanna
live in this town anymore!
scripts.translation:
[托拉夫]
啊...！
这真是让我受不了！
我没有钱搬家，
但我不想再住在这个城镇了！

scripts.text:
[Tollaf]
People everywhere else
live so much better than we
do, especially those snobs in
Einbroch! Einbech must be the
worst town Schwarzwald Republic. No, it's the worst in the world!
scripts.translation:
[托拉夫]
别处的人
生活得比我们好多了，
尤其是艾音布罗克那些势利眼！
艾音贝赫一定是修瓦鲁兹巴鲁德共和国最糟糕的城镇。
不，它是世界上最糟糕的！

scripts.text:
[Raust]
I don't get it!
Einbroch gets bigger
and fancier and our
town gets dirtier and
nastier. What the hell?!
scripts.translation:
[劳斯特]
我不明白！
艾音布罗克变得更大更豪华，
而我们的城镇却变得更脏更臭。
这到底是怎么回事？！

scripts.text:
[Raust]
Not only do the people
here look more ragged, we're
more tired and older looking
even! It's dirty, it's crowded,
everything in this city is total crap! What, you want a list?!
scripts.translation:
[劳斯特]
这里的人不仅看起来更邋遢，
我们看起来更疲惫更苍老！
这里很脏，很拥挤，
这个城市的一切都糟透了！
怎么，你想听我列个清单吗？！

scripts.text:
[Raust]
The food, literally, is
garbage! The jobs here have
to be violations of human rights. There's barely any women here and the ones we do have are all stank anyway! Are you convinced yet?!
scripts.translation:
[劳斯特]
这里的食物，简直
就是垃圾！
这里的工作肯定
违反了人权。
这里几乎没有女人，
而现有的几个也都臭烘烘的！
你被说服了吗？！

scripts.text:
[Raust]
Why is everything
that's good over in
Einbroch?! I hate this!
^333333*Grumble*^000000
scripts.translation:
[劳斯特]
为什么好的东西
都在艾音布罗克那边？！
我讨厌这里！
^333333*咕哝*^000000

scripts.text:
[Mjunia]
It's hard being a woman
in this town. By being born
here, it's like fate just decided to be especially cruel to me.
scripts.translation:
[缪尼娅]
在这个城镇当女人
很难。生在这里，
就像命运特意对我
格外残酷一样。

scripts.text:
[Mjunia]
My skin and hands are
rough from all the work
I have to do. But worst of
all... I... I... I've developed
bigger muscles than most
guys! Waaaaaah~!
scripts.translation:
[缪尼娅]
我的皮肤和双手
因为工作而变得粗糙。
但最糟糕的是...
我...我...我长出了
比大多数男人还大的肌肉！
哇啊啊啊~！

scripts.text:
[Mjunia]
I wish I could find
a nice guy from Einbroch
and get married so I can
get away from this town.
But it doesn't look like
that will happen...
scripts.translation:
[缪尼娅]
我真希望能找到一个
来自艾音布罗克的帅哥
结婚，这样我就能
离开这个城镇了。
但看起来
那不会发生...

scripts.text:
[Mjunia]
And I'd never marry
anyone from Einbech!
I'd rather die cold and
alone than cold and married
to some Einbech hooligan.
scripts.translation:
[缪尼娅]
我绝不会嫁给
任何艾音贝赫的人！
我宁愿孤独地死去，
也不愿嫁给艾音贝赫的
恶棍而孤独地死去。

scripts.text:
[Mjunia]
Look at these
muscles. What do
you think? Am I pretty?
^333333*Sniff*^000000 I gave up trying
to be feminine years ago.
I have to work so hard...
scripts.translation:
[缪尼娅]
看看这些肌肉。你觉得怎么样？我漂亮吗？
^333333*吸鼻子*^000000 我几年前就放弃变得女性化了。
我必须这么拼命地工作...

scripts.text:
[Ekuri]
Yo-heave-ho!
Yo-heave-ho~!
scripts.translation:
[埃库里]
嘿咻！
嘿咻~！

scripts.text:
[Ekuri]
What am I doing here?
Heck, I'm scared to death
of entering the mine! But
I can make a living here at
the entrance by gathering
scrap metal! Smart, huh?
scripts.translation:
[埃库里]
我在这儿干嘛呢？
天哪，我进矿洞怕得要死！
但我可以在入口捡废铁谋生！
挺聪明的，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Ekuri]
Sometimes, I get lucky
and score an entire ore!
Sure, I'm a coward, but
at least I'm alive. Well,
for the time being.
scripts.translation:
[埃库里]
有时候，我运气好
能捡到一整块矿石！
没错，我是个胆小鬼，
但至少我还活着。嗯，
暂时还活着。

scripts.text:
[Ekuri]
Now you know what
I'm doing here. So why
don't you leave me to
my work? Heave-ho!
Ores, come to me!
scripts.translation:
[埃库里]
现在你知道我在这儿干嘛了。
所以别打扰我工作，行吗？
嘿咻！
矿石们，到我这儿来！

scripts.text: Mine Dungeon Entrance
scripts.translation: 矿洞入口

scripts.text: Train Station
scripts.translation: 火车站

scripts.text: Freight Train Station
scripts.translation: 货运站

scripts.text: Tool Shop
scripts.translation: 工具店

scripts.text: Tavern
scripts.translation: 酒馆

scripts.text: Welcome to 'Einbech'.
scripts.translation: 欢迎来到“艾音贝赫”。

scripts.text:
East - Tavern, Tool Shop
North - Train Station, Mine Dungeon
scripts.translation:
东 - 酒馆，工具店
北 - 火车站，矿洞

scripts.text:
Northwest - Train Station
South - Tavern
North - Tool Shop, Mine Dungeon
scripts.translation:
西北 - 火车站
南 - 酒馆
北 - 工具店，矿洞

scripts.text:
[Tavern Lady]
Most Einbech men are
crude and primitive male
chauvinists! They disgust me!
scripts.translation:
[酒馆女老板]
艾音贝赫的大多数男人
都是粗鲁、原始的
男性沙文主义者！
他们让我恶心！

scripts.text:
[Tavern Lady]
I mean, there's nothing
good about them! They're
wild, violent, simple minded
and ignorant. They settle all
their arguments with brawn
and they're so... close minded!
scripts.translation:
[酒馆女老板]
我是说，他们一无是处！
他们野蛮、暴力、
头脑简单且无知。
他们解决所有争端都靠蛮力，
而且他们那么... 心胸狭窄！

scripts.text:
[Tavern Lady]
How can they not know
that women want gentle,
sensitive men with whom
they can share their feelings
and drink chamomile tea over
freshly knit doilies?
scripts.translation:
[酒馆女老板]
他们怎么就不明白，
女人想要的是温柔、
体贴的男人，
能与之分享情感，
并喝着洋甘菊茶，
看着新织的蕾丝垫？

scripts.text:
[R.D. Kim]
Oooh...

[R.D. Kim]
Oooh...
Momma.
scripts.translation:
[R.D. 金]
噢...
妈妈。

scripts.text:
[R.D. Kim]
Oooh...
Momma.
You are so...
scripts.translation:
[R.D. 金]
噢...
妈妈。
你真是...

scripts.text:
[R.D. Kim]
Oooh...
Momma.
You are so...
^FF0000Hot^000000!

[R.D. Kim]
Why don't you take off
those heavy, uncomfortable
clothes? I'll buy you whatever
you want, it's on me! C'mon~
scripts.translation:
[R.D. 金]
把那身又重又不舒服的衣服脱了吧！
想买什么我都给你买，我请客！来吧~

scripts.text:
[{0}]
N-no...!
I-I-I-I...
^666666(This is the
shadiest guy
I've ever seen!)^000000

[R.D. Kim]
Hm? No...?
Absolutely no?
Are you sure?
Alright, alright.
I'm sorry, I apologize.
I was totally out of line.
scripts.translation:
[R.D. 金]
嗯？不...？
绝对不？
你确定吗？
好吧，好吧。
对不起，我道歉。
我刚才太失礼了。

scripts.text:
[R.D. Kim]
...
Or am I?
Bwahahahaha!
scripts.translation:
[R.D. 金]
...
还是说...不是？
哇哈哈哈哈！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
(Th-this guy
must be drunk out
of his freakin' mind!)
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
(这家伙肯定是
醉得神志不清了！)

scripts.text:
[Shena]
I think it's weird!
How do you youngsters
not learn all of this?
scripts.translation:
[谢娜]
我觉得这很奇怪！
你们年轻人怎么
就不学学这些呢？

scripts.text:
[Luda]
Well, I'm sure the
generation gap has
something to do with it,
but I'm surprised that elder
people would know so much~
scripts.translation:
[露达]
嗯，这肯定和代沟
有关系，
但没想到长辈们
会知道这么多~

scripts.text: What are you guys talking about?
scripts.translation: 你们在聊什么？

scripts.text: Pass on by
scripts.translation: 路过

scripts.text:
[Shena]
Oh? Well, well!
Aren't you the most
adorable little girl?
Hello, dearie~
scripts.translation:
[谢娜]
哦？哎呀！
你真是最可爱的
小女孩了。
你好呀，亲爱的~

scripts.text: Excuse me, but I'm actually a guy.
scripts.translation: 抱歉，其实我是个男的。

scripts.text:
[Shena]
Oh, oh are you now?
Perhaps my eyes are
getting bad in my old
age. Getting harder to
tell the difference nowadays...
scripts.translation:
[谢娜]
哦，是吗？
也许是我老眼昏花了。
现在越来越难分辨了...

scripts.text:
[Shena]
Anyway, me and Luda
were just having a little
chat about all the monsters
near Einbroch. Apparently,
you youngsters don't know as
much about them as you should.
scripts.translation:
[谢娜]
总之，我和露达
刚才正在聊艾音布罗克
附近的魔物。
看来你们年轻人
对它们了解得还不够。

scripts.text:
[Shena]
If adventuring is your
business, you should
know what you're up against.
Did you have any questions
about the monsters around
here, young lady?
scripts.translation:
[谢娜]
如果冒险是你的职业，
就应该知道对手是谁。
关于这里的魔物，
你有什么问题吗，年轻女士？

scripts.text: I told you, I'm a dude...!
scripts.translation: 我说了，我是男的...！

scripts.text:
[Shena]
Hmm. ''Dude.'' I think
I've heard that before.
Ho ho~ You'll have to 
forgive this old biddy. 
I don't quite have a grasp
on all the words you kids use.
scripts.translation:
[谢娜]
嗯。“男的”。
我想我听过这个词。
呵呵~ 请原谅我这老太婆。
我不太懂你们年轻人用的词。

scripts.text:
[Shena]
So dearie,
which monster
would you like
to hear about?
scripts.translation:
[谢娜]
那么亲爱的，
你想听关于
哪种魔物的介绍？

scripts.text: Metalling
scripts.translation: 金属魔

scripts.text: Mineral
scripts.translation: 矿石魔

scripts.text: Pit Man
scripts.translation: 矿工幽灵

scripts.text: Old Stove
scripts.translation: 废铁暖炉

scripts.text: Quit
scripts.translation: 退出

scripts.text:
[Shena]
Well, the Metallings
were created during
the time when the gods
ruled over this world.
scripts.translation:
[谢娜]
嗯，金属魔是在众神统治这个世界的时代被创造出来的。

scripts.text:
[Shena]
I'm not sure if you knew
this or not, but according
to myth, Porings and Drops
were created from Odin's
saliva. You might not want
to know about Poporing...
scripts.translation:
[谢娜]
我不知道你是否知道，根据神话，波利和土波利是由奥丁的唾液创造的。你可能不想知道波波利的事...

scripts.text:
[Shena]
Metallings, on the
other hand, were made
from the blood of living
machines that I believe
were called ''Gigantes.''
scripts.translation:
[谢娜]
另一方面，金属魔是由被称为“古代中型基勘特斯”的活体机器的血液制成的。

scripts.text:
[Shena]
Metalling is still like
those other hopping
blobs of gelatin in that
they'll swallow whatever
might be lying on the ground.
scripts.translation:
[谢娜]
金属魔和那些其他跳来跳去的果冻团块一样，会吞掉地上可能存在的任何东西。

scripts.text:
[Shena]
If you defeat a Metalling,
it could drop Large Jellopy,
Iron Ore or even Iron. That
might be good to know, right?
scripts.translation:
[谢娜]
如果你击败金属魔，它可能会掉落巨大杰勒比结晶、铁矿石甚至铁。这或许是个好消息，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Shena]
Is there
anything else
you'd like to
ask, dearie?
scripts.translation:
[谢娜]
亲爱的，
你还有什么
想问的吗？

scripts.text:
[Shena]
Did you know that
stalactites and cave
crystals grow for thousands
and thousands of years?
scripts.translation:
[谢娜]
你知道吗，
钟乳石和洞穴水晶
生长了成千上万年？

scripts.text:
[Shena]
Now, if something's been
growing for thousands of
years, it would make sense
if it were actually alive. Now,
Mineral monsters are actually living stalactites.
scripts.translation:
[谢娜]
既然某样东西生长了数千年，
它实际上是活的也就说得通了。
现在，矿石魔实际上是活的钟乳石。

scripts.text:
[Shena]
It's rumored that they
are grown in a dark cave
in which something inside
has some sort of malicious
influence over them.
scripts.translation:
[谢娜]
据说它们生长在黑暗的洞穴中，
洞穴里的某种东西
对它们有着某种恶意的影响。

scripts.text:
[Shena]
Minerals can defend themselves,
but they might drop Crystal Piece, Topaz or Emvertacon if you defeat one. There's also a slim chance that they may drop a rare jewel, but I'm not quite sure.
scripts.translation:
[谢娜]
矿石魔可以自卫，
但如果你击败它们，
它们可能会掉落旗帜涂鸦、黄玉或翡翠。
还有很小的几率掉落稀有宝石，
但我不太确定。

scripts.text:
[Shena]
Are there any
other monsters
around here that
you'd want to learn
more about?
scripts.translation:
[谢娜]
这里还有其他魔物
你想了解更多吗？

scripts.text:
[Shena]
Pit Men are the ghosts
of dead miners that haunt
old and rusted mine cars.
For some reason, they can't
leave this world so they just
wander around the mines.
scripts.translation:
[谢娜]
矿工幽灵是死去的矿工的幽灵，
它们徘徊在古老生锈的矿车中。
不知为何，它们无法离开这个世界，
只能在矿井中徘徊。

scripts.text:
[Shena]
If you can defeat
them, they'll drop
Old Pick, Lantern, Iron,
Steel, Coal, Flashlight
and Old Iron Plate.
scripts.translation:
[谢娜]
如果你能击败它们，
它们会掉落老旧的十字镐、灯笼、铁、钢、煤、手电筒和旧铁板。

scripts.text:
[Shena]
Did you want
to ask me about
any other of the
local monsters?
scripts.translation:
[谢娜]
你想让我介绍
其他当地的魔物吗？

scripts.text:
[Shena]
It's just an evil,
man-eating stove.
scripts.translation:
[谢娜]
它只是一个邪恶的、吃人的暖炉。

scripts.text: ...That's it?
H-horrifying!
scripts.translation: 太...太可怕了！

scripts.text:
[Shena]
Now, you know the importance
of recycling and preserving our
natural resources, right? Now,
it would do my heart good if you were to recycle the scrap iron
from those Old Stove monsters.
scripts.translation:
[谢娜]
现在，你知道回收和保护自然资源的重要性，对吧？
如果你能回收那些废铁暖炉的废铁，我会很高兴的。

scripts.text:
[Shena]
Old Stoves will usually
drop Battered Pot, Burnt Tree,
Iron, Iron Ore and Old Iron Plate. But once in a while they might drop interesting items like Rusty Iron or even Dead Branch.
scripts.translation:
[谢娜]
废铁暖炉通常会掉落变形锅子、燃烧一半的木材、铁、铁矿石和旧铁板。但偶尔它们可能会掉落一些有趣的物品，比如锈铁，甚至是枯树枝。

scripts.text:
[Shena]
Yes. God's creation,
that creature is cruel
and merciless, perhaps
a symbol of purest evil
if I ever saw one.
scripts.translation:
[谢娜]
是的。那是神的造物，
那种生物残忍且无情，
或许是我见过的
最纯粹的邪恶的象征。

scripts.text:
[Shena]
Unlike newer appliances,
Old Stoves were hand made by
master craftsmen that, I guess,
developed their own souls. They
used to be benevolent machines, content to provide loving warmth.
scripts.translation:
[谢娜]
与新型家电不同，
废铁暖炉是由大师工匠手工制作的，
我想，它们发展出了自己的灵魂。
它们曾经是仁慈的机器，
满足于提供温暖的关怀。

scripts.text:
[Shena]
For years they would serve
their owners with loyalty. But
as technology advanced and
they became obsolete, they were
discarded like pieces of trash. This twisted their hearts to ^FF0000evil^000000.
scripts.translation:
[谢娜]
多年来，它们忠诚地
服务于它们的主人。但随着科技的进步
和它们变得过时，
它们被像垃圾一样丢弃。这扭曲了它们的心，使之变成了^FF0000邪恶^000000。

scripts.text:
[Shena]
Old Stoves will usually
drop Battered Pot, Burnt Tree,
Iron, Iron Ore and Old Iron Plate. But once in a while they might drop interesting items like Rusty Iron or even Dead Branch.
scripts.translation:
[谢娜]
废铁暖炉通常会掉落变形锅子、燃烧一半的木材、铁、铁矿石和旧铁板。但偶尔它们可能会掉落一些有趣的物品，比如锈铁，甚至是枯树枝。

scripts.text:
[Shena]
So, is there
anything else
you'd like me to
share with you?
scripts.translation:
[谢娜]
那么，还有什么
你想让我
分享的吗？

scripts.text:
[Shena]
Alright then.
Have a good
day, young lady.
scripts.translation:
[谢娜]
好的。
祝你今天愉快，
年轻女士。

scripts.text:
[Luda]
I'm sorry about my
mother! She can be
overly friendly, I suppose.
But if you're bored, please
feel free to visit. Be safe
on your travels, adventurer~
scripts.translation:
[露达]
抱歉我母亲的事！
她可能有点过于热情了。
但如果你无聊的话，
请随时来拜访。旅行平安，冒险者~

scripts.text:
[Shena]
Luda...
You don't live
to be as old as
I am and not learn
a little something
about this world of ours~
scripts.translation:
[谢娜]
露达...
活到我这个年纪，
总会对我们这个世界
学到一点东西~

scripts.text:
[Jung]
I'm one of the few
people who's lived
in both Einbech and
Einbroch for a long time.
So I guess I'm one of the
best guides of this area.
scripts.translation:
[郑]
我是少数几个
在艾音贝赫和艾音布罗克
都住了很久的人。
所以我想我是
这一带最好的向导之一。

scripts.text:
[Jung]
Say, if you're thinking of
entering the Mine Dungeon,
I can tell you all I know about
the monsters in that place so
that you'll be better prepared.
scripts.translation:
[郑]
嘿，如果你打算
进入米内地牢，
我可以告诉你关于那里
魔物的一切，
让你能更好地准备。

scripts.text: Sure, why not?
scripts.translation: 当然，为什么不呢？

scripts.text: No, thanks.
scripts.translation: 不用了，谢谢。

scripts.text:
[Jung]
Let's see. Ah, the monsters that are unique to the Mine Dungeon
are Noxious, Venomous, Pollcellio and Obsidian. Which one do you
want to know more about?
scripts.translation:
[郑]
让我看看。啊，米内地牢特有的魔物
是废气魔、毒液魔、Pollcellio和黑曜石。你想
了解哪一个？

scripts.text: Noxious and Venomous
scripts.translation: 废气魔和毒液魔

scripts.text: Pollcellio
scripts.translation: Pollcellio

scripts.text: Obsidian
scripts.translation: 黑曜石

scripts.text:
[Jung]
You know, no one seems
to know where Noxious and
Venomous have come from.
It's like they appeared out of
nowhere when Einbroch
started to industrialize.
scripts.translation:
[郑]
你知道吗，似乎没人知道
废气魔和毒液魔是从哪里来的。
它们就像在艾音布罗克
开始工业化时凭空出现的一样。

scripts.text:
[Jung]
Now that I think about it,
I don't think they're naturally created monsters. They have
this fixed look of despair and
suffering and tend to act like they want their enemies to kill them.
scripts.translation:
[郑]
现在想想，
我不认为它们是自然生成的魔物。它们有着
固定的绝望和痛苦的表情，
并且倾向于表现得像是希望敌人杀死它们。

scripts.text:
[Jung]
Still, you'd better be careful!
careful! Noxious and Venomous
are stealthy monsters that can
glide quietly through the air
and attack you before
you even notice...
scripts.translation:
[郑]
不过，你最好小心！
小心！废气魔和毒液魔
是潜行魔物，它们可以
在空气中无声地滑行，
在你甚至没注意到之前
就攻击你...

scripts.text:
[Jung]
You should know that
Noxious is Ghost property
and Venomous is Poison.
Both are medium sized,
formless monsters.
scripts.translation:
[郑]
你应该知道
废气魔是幽灵属性，
毒液魔是毒属性。
两者都是中等大小的
无形魔物。

scripts.text:
[Jung]
Both of them drop Apple,
Dust Pollutant, Toxic Gas,
Poisonous Powder, Bacillus,
Mold Powder and Anodyne.
scripts.translation:
[郑]
它们会掉落苹果、粉尘、有毒瓦斯、毒粉、杆菌、霉菌粉和镇痛剂。

scripts.text:
[Jung]
That's all for now.
Feel free to ask me
if you have any questions
about monsters in the Mine
Dungeon. Be safe, adventurer.
scripts.translation:
[郑]
暂时就这些。
如果您对矿洞里的魔物有任何问题，
随时可以问我。
祝旅途平安，冒险者。

scripts.text:
[Jung]
Pollcellio is an insect that
lives in caves and drinks water
dripped from stalactites. It's
different from Ungoliant since
it likes to be near different
kinds of minerals and ores.
scripts.translation:
[郑]
Pollcellio是一种生活在洞穴中的昆虫，
以钟乳石滴下的水为食。
它与温古力安特不同，
喜欢靠近各种矿石和矿物。

scripts.text:
[Jung]
Pollcellio drops Jubilee,
Insect Antenna, Single Cell,
Moss of Morning Dew, Neon
Liquid and a few other things
I can't quite remember.
scripts.translation:
[郑]
Pollcellio会掉落Jubilee、昆虫触角、单细胞、
晨露苔藓、霓虹液体，
还有一些我记不太清的东西。

scripts.text:
[Jung]
Lastly, Pollcellio is an
Earth property monster.
That's all I know about it.
But if you want to know more
about some other monster in the
Mine Dungeon, feel free to ask.
scripts.translation:
[郑]
最后，Pollcellio是土属性魔物。
关于它我就知道这些了。
但如果您想了解更多
矿洞里的其他魔物，
尽管问我。

scripts.text:
[Jung]
Do you know about the
belief that underground
minerals that contain huge
amounts of energy actually
have souls? Obsidian is
one of these living rocks.
scripts.translation:
[郑]
您听说过这种说法吗？
地下蕴含巨大能量的矿物
实际上拥有灵魂？
黑曜石就是这种活着的岩石之一。

scripts.text:
[Jung]
Supposedly, just a piece of an Obsidian in a Jung Processor has enough energy to light up the night sky. Unfortunately, it's impossible to capture one alive and hunting them isn't so easy.
scripts.translation:
[郑]
据说，只要将一块黑曜石放入郑处理器，
就足以照亮夜空。不幸的是，
很难活捉它们，狩猎它们也不容易。

scripts.text:
[Jung]
Obsidian is a small,
shapeless monster that
drops Clear Jewel, Piece of
Black Crystal, Coal, Elunium,
Iron and Steel.
scripts.translation:
[郑]
黑曜石是一种小型、无定形的魔物，
会掉落透明宝石、黑曜石碎片、煤炭、铝、
铁和钢。

scripts.text:
[Jung]
That's all for Obsidian.
If you have any questions
about other monsters living
in the Mine Dungeon, feel
free to ask me.
scripts.translation:
[郑]
关于黑曜石就这些了。
如果您对生活在矿洞里的
其他魔物有任何问题，
尽管问我。

scripts.text:
[Jung]
I understand if you're
kind of in a hurry. Still,
if you're pretty new around
here, you should learn as
much as you can before
entering any dungeons.
scripts.translation:
[郑]
我理解您可能赶时间。
不过，如果您刚到这里不久，
在进入任何副本之前，
最好尽可能多地了解信息。

scripts.text:
[Jung]
Alright then,
be safe on your
adventures, alright?
scripts.translation:
[郑]
那么，
祝您冒险旅途平安，
好吗？

scripts.text:
[Franz]
So bored...
Starving for...
Conversation.
S-somebody...
scripts.translation:
[弗朗茨]
好无聊...
渴望...
对话。
有...有人吗...

scripts.text:
[Franz]
Hey, a traveler!
Are you planning to explore
the Mine Dungeon or the fields
around here? Let's chat for a bit and maybe you'll learn something.
scripts.translation:
[弗朗茨]
嘿，旅行者！
你打算探索矿洞还是
附近的野外？
聊几句吧，也许你能学到点什么。

scripts.text: Okay, fine.
scripts.translation: 好吧，那就聊聊。

scripts.text: No, thanks.
scripts.translation: 不用了，谢谢。

scripts.text:
[Franz]
Ooh, have you heard
about the creature in the
Mine Dungeon or what's
happened in town recently?
Which would you like to
know more about?
scripts.translation:
[弗朗茨]
哦，你听说过
矿洞里的生物，或者
最近镇上发生的事吗？
你想先了解哪个？

scripts.text: Creature of Mine Dungeon
scripts.translation: 矿洞里的生物

scripts.text: Town Incident
scripts.translation: 镇上事件

scripts.text:
[Franz]
The creature I'm talking about is Ungoliant, which also called the Master of the Caves around here.
It's said to live deep in the caves where it guards peculiar ores and minerals with strange powers.
scripts.translation:
[弗朗茨]
我说的生物是温古力安特，
这里的人也叫它洞穴之主。
据说它深居洞穴，
守护着拥有奇异力量的特殊矿石和矿物。

scripts.text:
[Franz]
At first I thought it was
just an old fairy tale, but it
actually started appearing
again about ten years ago
when the tunnel cave-ins
started to happen.
scripts.translation:
[弗朗茨]
起初我以为那只是
古老的传说，
但大约十年前，
随着隧道塌方开始发生，
它真的再次出现了。

scripts.text:
[Franz]
As sightings of Ungoliant
increased, more and more
tunnel cave-ins occurred.
I guess the miners have
inadvertently intruded
into its territory.
scripts.translation:
[弗朗茨]
随着温古力安特的目击报告增加，
隧道塌方也变得越来越频繁。
我想矿工们
无意中侵入了它的领地。

scripts.text:
[Franz]
According to legend,
ancient giants snuck into
a mine to steal coal from
humans. But they made too
much noise while they were
digging and awoke Ungoliant.
scripts.translation:
[弗朗茨]
传说古代巨人曾潜入矿洞，
偷取人类的煤炭。
但它们在挖掘时
发出了太大的噪音，
惊醒了温古力安特。

scripts.text:
[Franz]
When the miners went to work
the next morning, they found the bloodied bodies of those giants.
After that, people have feared
the threat that Ungoliant poses
to anyone entering the mines.
scripts.translation:
[弗朗茨]
第二天早上，
矿工们去上班时，
发现了那些巨人血肉模糊的尸体。
从那以后，人们一直担心
温古力安特会对
进入矿洞的人构成威胁。

scripts.text:
[Franz]
Now, an adventurer that
managed to kill an Ungoliant
has told me that it drops Ant's
Jaw, Colorful Shell, Very Hard
Shell, Long Leg, Neon Liquid
and Zilcon.
scripts.translation:
[弗朗茨]
现在，有一位冒险者
成功击杀了温古力安特，
他告诉我它会掉落
蚂蚁的下颚、彩色贝壳、
坚硬贝壳、长腿、
荧光液体和锆石。

scripts.text:
[Franz]
In Einbroch, there was
a short lived teddy bear
fad. However, a series of
mysterious accidents and
murders where entire families
were killed also occurred.
scripts.translation:
[弗朗茨]
在艾音布罗克，
曾经短暂流行过泰迪熊。
然而，随之而来的是一系列
神秘的事故和谋杀案，
整个家庭都惨遭杀害。

scripts.text:
[Franz]
It turns out that every family
that had been murdered had
bought one of these teddy bears. There were even rumors that these teddy bears were coming to life.
scripts.translation:
[弗朗茨]
结果发现，
所有被杀害的家庭
都购买过这些泰迪熊。
甚至传言说这些泰迪熊
会活过来。

scripts.text:
[Franz]
After an investigation, the
authorities learned that all the merchants who sold these bears
had purchased them from the
same wholesaler, an outsider
no one knew anything about.
scripts.translation:
[弗朗茨]
经过调查，
当局得知所有出售这些熊的商人
都是从同一个批发商那里进货的，
那是一个没人知道底细的外地人。

scripts.text:
[Franz]
Since the teddy bears were
clearly not made to be mere,
harmless toys, troops were
sent to secure all the teddy
bears and dispose of them
outside of town.
scripts.translation:
[弗朗茨]
既然这些泰迪熊
显然不是普通的无害玩具，
军队就被派去
没收所有的泰迪熊，
并将它们运出城镇处理掉。

scripts.text:
[Franz]
But as soon as the teddy
bears were set outside of
town, they sprang to life and
started rioting! This is clear
proof that these bears are
controlled by some evil force.
scripts.translation:
[弗朗茨]
但泰迪熊刚被放到
城镇外面，
它们就活了过来，
并开始暴动！
这清楚地证明这些熊
是被某种邪恶力量控制的。

scripts.text:
[Franz]
Now those aggressive teddy
bears are scattered all over
the place and the government
has classified them as monsters. Kill with extreme prejudice!
scripts.translation:
[弗朗茨]
现在那些好斗的泰迪熊
四处散开，
政府已将它们列为魔物。
格杀勿论！

scripts.text:
[Franz]
According to adventurers
who have caught these bears,
they're small, neutral monsters
which drop Honey, Screw, Well-baked Cookie and Oridecon Hammer.
scripts.translation:
[弗朗茨]
根据捕获过这些熊的冒险者说，
它们是小型的中立魔物，
会掉落蜂蜜、螺丝、
姜饼和神之金属锤子。

scripts.text:
[Franz]
That's all I know
about it. Watch out
for those bears if you
go exploring, okay? They
may be cute, but they're
known to be extremely vicious!
scripts.translation:
[弗朗茨]
我所知道的就是这些。
如果你去探索，
小心那些熊，好吗？
它们可能很可爱，
但据说极其凶残！

scripts.text:
[Franz]
Oh, okay.
You're busy and you have
things to do, I understand.
You probably have to head
off somewhere right away.
Right. Got it.
scripts.translation:
[弗朗茨]
哦，好的。
你很忙，有事情要做，
我理解。
你大概得马上出发去别处了。
好的，明白了。

scripts.text:
[Franz]
I...
I've got stuff
I should be working
on. Yes. So very busy.
scripts.translation:
[弗朗茨]
我...
我也有些工作
要处理。是的。
非常忙。
